card.name: Renal function in NSAID interaction warnings
card.fires_on: The word "function" in "deterioration of renal function" in NSAID plus ACE inhibitor or ARB interaction warnings, just before ", including possible acute renal failure". It also fires on "including" after a worsening effect.

modes.label: Renal function before including
modes.description: The word function after "deterioration of renal" in NSAID interaction warnings.
modes.example: may result in deterioration of renal<< function>>, including possible acute renal failure. These

modes.label: Including after blood pressure rise
modes.description: The word including right after a named adverse effect, introducing a more severe example.
modes.example: Significant elevation in blood pressure (BP),<< including>> hypertensive crisis with acute impairment of organ

card.writes: It seems to favor a comma-and-"including" continuation that names a severe outcome, while suppressing words like changes or necessary.
card.plain: It marks the point in an NSAID interaction warning where "renal function" is followed by a worse example such as acute kidney failure.
